title: MOTION (McOSKER - HUTT) relative to reactivating and restoring Council file No. 02-1520.
text:
[Council File 26-1397]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (McOSKER - HUTT) relative to reactivating and restoring Council file No. 02-1520.
Recommendation for Council action:
REACTIVATE and RESTORE the matter relative to the implementation of a Decentralized Regional District System for delivery of services to all the people of Los Angeles, as recorded under Council file No. 02-1520, which expired pursuant to Council policy (Council file No. 05-0553), to its most recent legislative status as of the date of the File's expiration.
summary: Council is asked to reactivate and restore an expired council file on a decentralized regional district system for delivering city services to its last legislative status.

details.action: reactivate and restore expired council file

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 13, 2026)
